Geographies Served Programs Educate & Empower Programme District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu The Educate and Empower programme, offers scholarships and support to students, including fee payments and the provision of smartphones for remote learning. The Let’s Learn initiative, provides interactive remote education for Government primary school children via WhatsApp video and Zoom classes, maintaining a teacher-student ratio of 1:2 for optimal learning. Partnering with Altius Foundation for "I wanna learn," a Math learning platform, aiming to provide laptops and establish computer labs in schools to enhance math education for grades 6th to 8th. Construct a primary school in Perumbakkam District Alappuzha Chennai State Tamil Nadu Kerala District Alappuzha Chennai States Tamil Nadu Kerala In response to the Chennai Floods of 2015, it initiated a project to construct a primary school in Perumbakkam, Chennai's major resettlement area, catering to over 18,000 families. The 16,000 sq ft school, equipped with 14 classrooms, a library, a computer lab, and staff rooms, will accommodate 500 children, enhancing their learning environment. Scheduled for completion in April 2021, the school ensures proper lighting, ventilation, and sanitation facilities. Similarly, following the Kerala rains in 2018, Bhoomika embarked on a project to rebuild a flood-damaged high school in Kuttamangalam, Alappuzha district, with a stilted structure comprising five classrooms, administrative rooms, and toilets, aiming for completion by September 2021. These efforts align with its broader mission to educate and empower vulnerable communities. Milestones & Track Record Bhoomika Trust has responded to major disasters since 2001, established long-term rehabilitation and education programs, and initiated projects like constructing schools in resettlement areas after the 2015 Chennai floods. --> --> Leadership Team Aruna Subramaniam Trustee Jayendra Panchapakesan Trustee Sudha Panchapakesan Trustee M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATB3967D Registration Number 133/2001/BK4 CSR Form 1 Not Available 80G AAATB3967DF20214 12A AAATB3967DE20214 FCRA 75901104 About Headquarters Chennai, Tamil Nadu Since 2001 Demographies Served Youth Women Children Men --> Impact Bhoomika Trust has provided disaster relief and rehabilitation after major events like the 2001 Gujarat Earthquake, 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami, and 2015 Chennai Floods, as well as establishing education programs for underprivileged children. Vision and Mission Bhoomika Trust aims to rebuild lives and livelihoods after disasters, and work with underprivileged communities to provide disaster relief and enhance children's education to cultivate inquisitive minds, creativity and empathy.
